Không suy ra thành công, retry, khóa tài khoản hoặc kết quả gửi/nhận từ việc có dòng danh mục; đối chiếu detail/log và runtime. Dòng có thể được seed, lưu từ Automation hoặc tự sinh khi runtime ghi detail. Mô tả chỉ phục vụ agent, không tham gia điều kiện chạy.'::text

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auto_campaign_details_pkey ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_account_id ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_campaign_id ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (campaign_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_input_data_id ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (input_data_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_rate_limit ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (account_id, action_name, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaign_details_action_rate ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (account_id, action_code, created_at) WHERE ((is_delete = false) AND (action_code IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaign_details_automation_status ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (campaign_id, status, action_code, created_at DESC) WHERE (is_delete = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaign_details_automation_detail ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (auto_automation_detail_id, created_at, id) WHERE (auto_automation_detail_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_page ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (campaign_id, created_at, id) WHERE (is_delete = false)

CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_delivery_cooldown ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (account_id, action_code, created_at DESC, input_data_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['thành công'::text, 'đã gửi'::text, 'đã nhận'::text, 'đã xem'::text, 'đã click'::text]))
CREATE INDEX auto_campaign_engagement_source ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (id) WHERE (((data ->> 'zaloEngagementPending'::text) = 'true'::text) AND (is_delete = false))

CREATE INDEX auto_campaign_engagement_operation ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (campaign_id, account_id, ((data #>> '{zaloEngagementSource,operationId}'::text[]))) WHERE ((data #>> '{zaloEngagementSource,operationId}'::text[]) IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_sms_input_data_campaign_status_schedule ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, status, schedule, created_at, id) WHERE (COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auto_campaign_input_data_pkey ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_campaign_id ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_input_id ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (input_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_status ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (status) WHERE (is_delete = false)

CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_phone_carrier_status_schedule ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, phone_carrier, status, schedule) WHERE ((is_delete = false) AND (phone_carrier IS NOT NULL))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auto_campaign_input_data_control_append ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, control_append_idempotency_key, control_append_row_index) WHERE (control_append_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auto_campaign_input_data_automation_detail ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (auto_automation_detail_id) WHERE (auto_automation_detail_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_auto_campaign_input_data_canonical_target ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, canonical_target_key) WHERE ((canonical_target_key IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false))
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_progress_live ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, status) WHERE (is_delete = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_inputs_semantic_type ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, data_type_category_item_id, id) WHERE (COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false)
